Methods for Markermd Template Classes

Source: R/template-methods.R
template_methods.Rd

Console methods for the S7 template classes: print() for templates, questions, node selections and template metadata, and length() for templates (the number of questions) and node selections (the number of selected node ids). Validation lives in the class validators and serialization in read_template_yaml() / write_template_yaml().

Developed by Colin Rundel.
